youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用修理Wi-Fi網路情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從發現斷線、重啟路由器、排除訊號死角，到致電客服升級修復。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Troubleshooting the Wi-Fi phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering spotting an outage, restarting the router, fixing dead zones, and calling customer service. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The Wi-Fi stopped working again.
dialogue.zh: Wi-Fi 又不會動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did the whole internet just drop?
dialogue.zh: 整個網路剛剛斷線了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, my video froze mid-scene.
dialogue.zh: 對，我的影片卡在劇情中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine can't load anything either.
dialogue.zh: 我的也什麼都載不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is your phone on the same network?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz jʊr foʊn ɑn ðə seɪm ˈnɛtˌwɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 你的手機連的是同一個網路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, I switched to mobile data.
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我改用行動數據了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So only our home Wi-Fi is down.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈoʊnli aʊr hoʊm ˈwaɪˌfaɪ ɪs daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 所以只有家裡的 Wi-Fi 斷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It happened right after dinner too.
dialogue.zh: 而且剛好是吃完飯之後發生的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The router lights are all red.
dialogue.zh: 路由器的燈全變成紅色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually they glow a steady green.
dialogue.zh: 平常它們應該是穩定的綠色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One light keeps blinking fast now.
dialogue.zh: 有一盞燈現在一直快速閃爍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That blinking means no connection.
dialogue.zh: 那種閃爍代表沒有連線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did a storm pass by earlier?
dialogue.zh: 剛剛有雷雨經過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, thunder woke up the cat.
dialogue.zh: 有啊，打雷把貓吵醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe lightning hit the power line.
dialogue.zh: 也許閃電打到了電線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That could knock out the signal.
dialogue.zh: 那可能會讓訊號中斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The TV says no connection found.
dialogue.zh: 電視顯示找不到網路連線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It even tried to reconnect twice.
dialogue.zh: 它甚至嘗試重新連線兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My laptop shows the small warning icon.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlæptɑp foʊz ðə smɔl ˈwɔrnɪŋ ˈaɪˌkɑn./
dialogue.zh: 我的筆電顯示那個小警告圖示。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The globe with a little cross, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə gloʊb wɪð ə ˈlɪtəl krɔs, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 就是那個帶小叉號的地球圖，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly. I hate that symbol.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我討厭那個符號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means no Wi-Fi at all.
dialogue.zh: 它代表完全沒有 Wi-Fi。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the internet was fine this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ˈɪntərˌnɛt wʌz faɪn ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 可是今天早上網路還好好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Something changed while we were out.
dialogue.zh: 我們出門的時候出了狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you stream music right now?
dialogue.zh: 你現在能串流音樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it buffers and then stalls.
dialogue.zh: 不能，它一直緩衝然後卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The smart speaker won't answer me.
dialogue.zh: 智慧音箱都不理我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It just blinks that orange light.
dialogue.zh: 它只是閃著橘色的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Orange means offline, I think.
dialogue.zh: 橘色應該是離線的意思。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, it can't reach the server.
dialogue.zh: 對，它連不上伺服器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I did lose power for a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd luz ˈpaʊər fər ə ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 我這邊確實停電了一瞬間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fridge clock is flashing twelve.
dialogue.zh: 冰箱的時鐘一直在閃十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? The outage reset everything.
dialogue.zh: 看吧？停電把所有東西重置了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the modem still looks powered on.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ˈmodɛm stɪl lʊks ˈpaʊərd ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 不過數據機看起來還是有電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its lights are on, but useless.
dialogue.zh: 它的燈亮著，但沒用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe it lost the provider feed.
dialogue.zh: 也許它斷掉了業者的訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's a provider feed exactly?
dialogue.zh: 業者的訊號到底是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The line that brings internet here.
dialogue.zh: 就是把網路送到家裡的那條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the thick black cord then.
dialogue.zh: 噢，那就是那條黑色粗線吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, follow it to the wall.
dialogue.zh: 對，沿著它找到牆邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels warm to the touch.
dialogue.zh: 它摸起來溫溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm is normal, hot is not.
dialogue.zh: 溫的很正常，燙就不對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's just warm, thankfully.
dialogue.zh: 還好只是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, no burning smell either?
dialogue.zh: 好，那也沒有燒焦味吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: None that I can notice.
dialogue.zh: 我沒聞到任何燒焦味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that rules out a fire risk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðæt rulz aʊt ə ˈfaɪər rɪsk./
dialogue.zh: 好，那就排除了火災風險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's check the other rooms first.
dialogue.zh: 我們先檢查其他房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll check the bedroom first.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我先去臥室查查看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, how's the bedroom looking?
dialogue.zh: 那麼，臥室那邊狀況如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Zero bars, a totally empty circle.
dialogue.zh: 完全沒格，圈圈是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same here in the kitchen.
dialogue.zh: 廚房這邊也一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bathroom isn't any better.
dialogue.zh: 浴室也沒有比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the whole house has no net.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə hoʊl haʊz hæz noʊ nɛt./
dialogue.zh: 所以整間房子都沒網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every room shows the same blank screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri rum foʊz ðə seɪm blæŋk skrɪn./
dialogue.zh: 每個房間都是同樣的空白畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tablets are all frozen too.
dialogue.zh: 平板也全都卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even the baby monitor went quiet.
dialogue.zh: 連嬰兒監視器都安靜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one is on Wi-Fi too?
dialogue.zh: 那個也是靠 Wi-Fi 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so it dropped with the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, soʊ ɪt drɑpt wɪð ðə rɛst./
dialogue.zh: 對，所以它跟其他的一起斷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing works without this internet.
dialogue.zh: 沒了網路什麼都動不了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, I still need my report.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ, aɪ stɪl nid maɪ rɪˈpɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 我懂，我報告還沒交呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we use phones as a hotspot?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi juz foʊnz æz ə ˈhɑtˌspɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能用手機開熱點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My data plan is almost gone.
dialogue.zh: 我的數據流量快用完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine only has a little left.
dialogue.zh: 我的也只剩一點點了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better save it for real emergencies.
dialogue.zh: 最好留給真正的急用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Agreed. Let's fix the Wi-Fi itself.
dialogue.zh: 同意，我們來修 Wi-Fi 本身。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds good, count me in.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，算我一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, is anyone downloading right now?
dialogue.zh: 首先，現在有人在下載嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they all stopped dead in place.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðeɪ ɔl stɑpt dɛd ɪn pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，全都原地停住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the network name disappear?
dialogue.zh: 網路名稱消失了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, our name still shows up fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, aʊr neɪm stɪl foʊz ʌp faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們的名稱還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it's broadcasting but not connected.
dialogue.zh: 所以它在廣播但沒連線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the router is up, the line is out.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðə ˈraʊtər ɪz ʌp, ðə laɪn ɪz aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 對，路由器運作著，但線路斷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's confusing but useful to know.
dialogue.zh: 有點繞但很有用的線索。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means the router isn't fully dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt minz ðə ˈraʊtər ˈɪzənt ˈfʊli dɛd./
dialogue.zh: 代表路由器沒有完全壞掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, that's one less worry.
dialogue.zh: 好，少一個煩惱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the password screen keeps failing us.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə ˈpæswɜrd skrɪn kips ˈfeɪlɪŋ ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 但密碼畫面一直讓我們失敗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says incorrect password every time.
dialogue.zh: 每次都顯示密碼錯誤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even though we never changed it.
dialogue.zh: 我們明明從來沒改過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the reboot messed up the login.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə riˈbut mɛst ʌp ðə ˈlɑˌɡɪn./
dialogue.zh: 也許重開機把登入搞亂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Login here means the admin page.
dialogue.zh: 這裡的登入指的是管理頁面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I've never opened that page before.
dialogue.zh: 我以前從沒打開過那個頁面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Neither have I, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說我也沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's not get lost in settings yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts nɑt ɡɛt lɔst ɪn ˈsɛtɪŋz jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 先別在設定裡迷路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, simple steps first.
dialogue.zh: 同意，先從簡單的步驟開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long since the last reboot?
dialogue.zh: 上次重開機是多久以前？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, I don't remember at all.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，我完全不記得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Me neither, maybe months ago.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，也許幾個月前吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That alone can cause weird glitches.
dialogue.zh: 光是這樣就能造成怪異的毛病。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Glitches like freezing and random drops?
dialogue.zh: 像是卡住和隨機斷線那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly those annoying little problems.
dialogue.zh: 正是那些煩人的小毛病。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, at least we know the symptom.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, æt list wi noʊ ðə ˈsɪmptəm./
dialogue.zh: 好吧，起碼我們知道症狀了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No internet, red lights, stubborn login.
dialogue.zh: 沒網路、紅燈、卡住的登入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And every device acts the same.
dialogue.zh: 而且每台裝置表現都一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the fault sits at the source.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə fɔlt sɪts æt ðə sɔrs./
dialogue.zh: 所以問題出在源頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Source means the modem and wall line.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɔrs minz ðə ˈmodɛm ænd wɔl laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 源頭是指數據機和牆上的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Now we know where to look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt. naʊ wi noʊ wɛr tə lʊk./
dialogue.zh: 懂了，現在知道該看哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we start with a restart?
dialogue.zh: 我們該先重啟嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's our first real move.
dialogue.zh: 對，那是我們的第一步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, let's do this together.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們一起來弄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hand on the power plug.
dialogue.zh: 手放到電源插頭上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Unplug it from the wall outlet.
dialogue.zh: 把它從牆上的插座拔掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. The lights are dying already.
dialogue.zh: 好了，燈已經在熄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I unplug the modem too?
dialogue.zh: 數據機也要一起拔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pull the modem as well.
dialogue.zh: 要，數據機也一併拔掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both are off now. So quiet.
dialogue.zh: 兩台都關了，好安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we wait a full minute.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們要等滿一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why wait? Can't I just plug back?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ weɪt? kænt aɪ dʒʌst plʌɡ bæk?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要等？不能馬上插回去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It clears leftover memory that way.
dialogue.zh: 那樣才能清掉機裡殘留的資料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leftover junk, got it.
dialogue.zh: 殘留的垃圾，懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it sixty seconds, no cheating.
dialogue.zh: 給它六十秒，別偷跑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll start counting on my phone.
dialogue.zh: 我用手機開始數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll watch the little lights.
dialogue.zh: 好，我盯著那些小燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifteen seconds gone already.
dialogue.zh: 十五秒已經過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep going, don't rush it yet.
dialogue.zh: 繼續，先別急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty now. Halfway point.
dialogue.zh: 三十秒了，過一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, you're doing great so far.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，目前進展很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty-five. Almost there.
dialogue.zh: 四十五，快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on ten more to be safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn tɛn mɔr tə bi seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 再多數十秒比較保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty! Time to plug back in.
dialogue.zh: 六十秒！該插回去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plug the modem in first, please.
dialogue.zh: 請先插數據機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Modem is plugged. What's next?
dialogue.zh: 數據機插好了，接著呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait till its lights settle down.
dialogue.zh: 等它的燈穩定下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A few lights blinked awake.
dialogue.zh: 有幾盞燈眨眼醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the boot-up starting now.
dialogue.zh: 那是開機程序剛開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does boot-up take?
dialogue.zh: 開機要花多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About two minutes for a modem.
dialogue.zh: 數據機大概兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll wait patiently.
dialogue.zh: 好，我會耐心地等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't touch it while it wakes.
dialogue.zh: 它開機時別去碰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some lights turned green already.
dialogue.zh: 有些燈已經變綠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good sign. It's getting online.
dialogue.zh: 好兆頭，它正連上線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One is still orange, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過還有一盞是橘色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the internet light. Give it time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ði ˈɪntərˌnɛt laɪt. ɡɪv ɪt taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 那是網路燈，再給它點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still blinking orange. Hmm.
dialogue.zh: 還在閃橘色，嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It can't reach outside yet.
dialogue.zh: 它還連不到外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I'll plug the router in.
dialogue.zh: 現在我來插路由器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the modem looks ready now.
dialogue.zh: 好，數據機現在準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Router's plugged in. Lights are coming on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈraʊtərz plʌɡd ɪn. laɪts ɑr ˈkʌmɪŋ ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 路由器插好了，燈一盞盞亮起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One by one, like a Christmas tree.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn baɪ wʌn, laɪk ə ˈkrɪsməs tri./
dialogue.zh: 一盞接一盞，像棵聖誕樹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Haha, it does look festive.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，看起來真有節日氣氛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the top light just went green.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə tɑp laɪt dʒʌst wɛnt ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 現在最上面那盞變綠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is green the online signal?
dialogue.zh: 綠色就是上線的訊號嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's the internet connection light.
dialogue.zh: 對，那是網路連線燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's solid green. No blinking!
dialogue.zh: 穩定綠色，不閃了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's exactly what we wanted.
dialogue.zh: 這正是我們想要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I reconnect my phone now?
dialogue.zh: 我現在重連手機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, open the Wi-Fi list.
dialogue.zh: 好，打開 Wi-Fi 清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our network name popped right up.
dialogue.zh: 我們的網路名稱跳出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it and enter the password.
dialogue.zh: 點它並輸入密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's the tricky part again.
dialogue.zh: 麻煩的部分又來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you forget the password?
dialogue.zh: 你忘記密碼了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I type it but it keeps failing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ taɪp ɪt bʌt ɪt kips ˈfeɪlɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我打了卻一直失敗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's check the sticker under the router.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts tʃɛk ðə ˈstɪkər ˈʌndər ðə ˈraʊtər./
dialogue.zh: 我們看看路由器底下的貼紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, the default info card!
dialogue.zh: 對哦，預設資訊卡！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flip it over slowly, be careful.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢把它翻過來，小心點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see a network name here.
dialogue.zh: 這裡有個網路名稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a password line below it.
dialogue.zh: 下面還有密碼那一行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But we changed the name years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt wi ʧeɪnd ðə neɪm jɪrz əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 可是我們幾年前改過名稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The password might be the old default.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpæswɜrd maɪt bi ði oʊld dɪˈfɔlt./
dialogue.zh: 密碼說不定還是舊的預設值。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me try this long code.
dialogue.zh: 讓我試試這串長碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it with the capital letters.
dialogue.zh: 大寫字母也要照著打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Caps make it so easy to mess up.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæps meɪk ɪt soʊ ˈizi tə mɛs ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 大小寫很容易讓人打錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me your screen; let's compare.
dialogue.zh: 給我看你的螢幕，我們比對一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? I typed it so carefully.
dialogue.zh: 看？我很仔細地打了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looks right; try to connect anyway.
dialogue.zh: 看起來對，總之再連看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Connecting now, and it's spinning.
dialogue.zh: 正在連接，一直轉圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spinning means it's still trying.
dialogue.zh: 轉圈代表它還在嘗試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says connected, but no internet.
dialogue.zh: 顯示已連接，但沒網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh, that's the classic near-miss.
dialogue.zh: 唉，真的是就差那麼一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So close, yet still so far.
dialogue.zh: 這麼近，卻又那麼遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's set the password aside a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts sɛt ðə ˈpæswɜrd əˈsaɪd ə ˈsɛkənd./
dialogue.zh: 我們先把密碼放一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we look at instead?
dialogue.zh: 那我們該看些別的什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the modem's main light once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈmodɛmz meɪn laɪt wʌns mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 再看一次數據機的主燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It went green, then flashed red.
dialogue.zh: 它變綠，然後閃紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flashing red means a line problem.
dialogue.zh: 閃紅代表線路有問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line problem? Like the cable itself?
dialogue.zh: 線路問題？像是線本身？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe it's loose in the port.
dialogue.zh: 說不定是接口鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The port is where the cord clicks in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɔrt ɪz wɛr ðə kɔrd klɪks ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 接口就是線卡進去的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes. Push it snug, but gently.
dialogue.zh: 對，把它推緊，但要輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I wiggled it. It felt a little loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈwɪɡəld ɪt. ɪt fɛlt ə ˈlɪtəl lus./
dialogue.zh: 我晃了晃，感覺有點鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the other matching port beside it.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ði ˈʌðər ˈmætʃɪŋ pɔrt bɪˈsaɪd ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 試試旁邊另一個相同的接口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swapped it in with a firm click.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑpt ɪt ɪn wɪð ə fɜrm klɪk./
dialogue.zh: 我把它換邊插進去，卡嗒一聲扣得很實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now let's see if it holds green.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛts si ɪf ɪt hoʊldz ɡrin./
dialogue.zh: 現在看綠燈能不能穩住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's steady! No more red flash.
dialogue.zh: 穩住了！不再閃紅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Progress! Let the modem settle a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɑɡrɛs! lɛt ðə ˈmodɛm ˈsɛtəl ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 有進展！讓數據機穩定一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, one more minute of patience.
dialogue.zh: 好，再耐心等一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we retest the phone connection.
dialogue.zh: 然後我們再測手機連線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone says connected with internet!
dialogue.zh: 我手機顯示已連接且有網路！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! Open a page to double-check.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs! ˈoʊpən ə peɪdʒ tə ˈdəbəl tʃɛk./
dialogue.zh: 太好了！開個網頁再確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It loaded a photo super fast.
dialogue.zh: 它超快就載入了一張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means the hard part worked.
dialogue.zh: 代表最難的部分成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So was it the loose port all along?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌz ɪt ðə lus pɔrt ɔl əˈlɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 所以從頭到尾是接口鬆了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A loose line can wreck everything.
dialogue.zh: 一條鬆脫的線能搞砸一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, an actual easy fix for once.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ, æn ˈæktʃuəl ˈizi fɪks fər wʌns./
dialogue.zh: 哇，難得一次好修的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't celebrate too early, though.
dialogue.zh: 不過別太早慶祝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why? Isn't the light green now?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？燈現在不是綠的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check your laptop across the house.
dialogue.zh: 去檢查屋子另一頭的筆電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the far bedroom might struggle.
dialogue.zh: 對，那間遠的臥室可能較吃力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's go test the signal up there.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ɡoʊ tɛst ðə ˈsɪɡnəl ʌp ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我們去那邊測試訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lead the way, network doctor.
dialogue.zh: 帶路吧，網路醫生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next stop is the dead-zone hunt.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst stɑp ɪz ðə dɛd zoʊn hʌnt./
dialogue.zh: 下一站就是搜尋訊號死角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm standing in the far bedroom.
dialogue.zh: 我現在站在最遠的臥室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And how many bars do you see?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd haʊ ˈmɛni bɑrz du ju si?/
dialogue.zh: 你看到幾格訊號？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Barely two, and they keep flickering.
dialogue.zh: 勉強兩格，還一直在跳。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That room is our dead zone.
dialogue.zh: 那間就是我們的死角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Videos won't even start playing.
dialogue.zh: 影片根本沒辦法開始播。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two bars can't carry much load.
dialogue.zh: 兩格撐不起多少流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hallway is a little better.
dialogue.zh: 走廊那邊好一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three bars there, buffering sometimes.
dialogue.zh: 那裡三格，有時會緩衝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So distance is really the culprit.
dialogue.zh: 所以距離其實是元凶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Distance and these thick old walls.
dialogue.zh: 距離加上這些厚實的老牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walls eat the signal, huh?
dialogue.zh: 牆會吃掉訊號，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Brick and metal hurt it most.
dialogue.zh: 磚塊和金屬對它傷得最重。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our bathroom wall is tiled solid.
dialogue.zh: 我們浴室的牆面貼滿了磁磚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why it dies in there.
dialogue.zh: 難怪訊號在裡面總是斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The big fridge blocks it too.
dialogue.zh: 大冰箱也會擋住訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Metal appliances are Wi-Fi enemies.
dialogue.zh: 金屬家電是 Wi-Fi 的敵人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, I never thought about that.
dialogue.zh: 哇，我從沒想過這點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where we place things really matters.
dialogue.zh: 東西擺在哪裡真的很關鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The router sits inside a closet.
dialogue.zh: 路由器擺在收納櫃裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That could be our whole problem.
dialogue.zh: 那說不定就是問題的主因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hidden behind a closed door.
dialogue.zh: 藏在一扇關著的門後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closed spaces trap the signal badly.
dialogue.zh: 封閉空間會把訊號悶住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's move the router out right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts muv ðə ˈraʊtər aʊt raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們馬上把路由器搬出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it somewhere high and open.
dialogue.zh: 擺到又高又開闊的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: High means the top of a shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ minz ðə tɑp əv ə ʃɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 高是指架子的最上層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, signals spread down and out.
dialogue.zh: 對，訊號會往下和往外散。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So up high covers more rooms.
dialogue.zh: 所以擺高能覆蓋更多房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, height helps it travel.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，擺高能幫訊號傳更遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll clear the middle of the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl klɪr ðə ˈmɪdəl əv ðə ˈteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 我把桌子的中間清出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That works better than a high shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrks ˈbɛtər ðæn ə haɪ ʃɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 擺在桌子中間比高架子更好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cords are short though. A problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɔrdz ɑr ʃɔrt ðoʊ. ə ˈprɑbləm?/
dialogue.zh: 不過線很短，會有問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can buy a longer power cord.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn baɪ ə ˈlɔŋər ˈpaʊər kɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 我們可以買更長的電源線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or just move the table closer here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr dʒʌst muv ðə ˈteɪbəl ˈkloʊsər hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 或乾脆把桌子搬近一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also fine, as long as it's central.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ faɪn, æz lɔŋ æz ɪts ˈsɛntrəl./
dialogue.zh: 也行，只要位置靠中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Central means the house's middle point.
dialogue.zh: 中間就是房子的正中心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so no room is too far.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, soʊ noʊ rum ɪz tu fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 對，這樣就沒有房間太遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, it's on the table now.
dialogue.zh: 好，它現在擺在桌子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a minute to settle.
dialogue.zh: 給它一分鐘穩定下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Settle? The router needs air?
dialogue.zh: 穩定？路由器也需要空氣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shouldn't be smothered or covered.
dialogue.zh: 它不該被悶住或蓋住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old spot was totally shut in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði oʊld spɑt wʌz ˈtoʊtəli ʃʌt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 舊位置那個空間整個悶死。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat also weakens a struggling router.
dialogue.zh: 太熱也會拖垮本來就吃力的路由器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's retest that far bedroom.
dialogue.zh: 現在再測一次那間臥室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll go stand right by the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ɡoʊ stænd raɪt baɪ ðə bɛd./
dialogue.zh: 我去站到床旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell me your bars this time.
dialogue.zh: 告訴我這一次的格數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three now, up from just two!
dialogue.zh: 現在三格，從兩格升上來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, but still not great.
dialogue.zh: 好一些了，但仍不夠好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The far wall still blocks a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɑr wɔl stɪl blɑks ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 那面遠牆還是擋掉很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Videos load, just very slowly.
dialogue.zh: 影片能載入，只是很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slow beats broken, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，慢總比壞了好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: True. But can we do better?
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，但我們能做得更好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We could add a signal extender.
dialogue.zh: 我們可以加一個訊號延伸器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An extender? What does that do?
dialogue.zh: 延伸器？那是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It catches the signal and repeats it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈkætʃɪz ðə ˈsɪɡnəl ænd rɪˈpits ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 它接住訊號再中繼出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So it boosts the weak rooms?
dialogue.zh: 所以它能增強訊號弱的房間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it fills in the dead zones.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt fɪlz ɪn ðə dɛd zoʊnz./
dialogue.zh: 對，它會把死角補起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we already own one?
dialogue.zh: 我們家裡已經有一個了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I think there's one in the drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ðɛrz wʌn ɪn ðə drɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我想抽屜裡有一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's grab it and try it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ɡræb ɪt ænd traɪ ɪt aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 我們拿出來試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, no need to buy more.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，不用另外買。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's this tiny white plug thing.
dialogue.zh: 就是這個白色的小插頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, it plugs right into a wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jæ, ɪt plʌɡz raɪt ˈɪntə ə wɔl./
dialogue.zh: 對，它直接插進牆壁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should I place the extender?
dialogue.zh: 延伸器該擺在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Halfway between the router and the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæfˌweɪ bɪˈtin ðə ˈraʊtər ænd ðə rum./
dialogue.zh: 放在路由器和房間的正中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So not right beside the router?
dialogue.zh: 所以不是緊挨著路由器？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it won't spread any further.
dialogue.zh: 不，那樣訊號傳不了更遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And not all the way at the end?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd nɑt ɔl ðə weɪ æt ði ɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 那也不是放到最尾端？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, midway reaches the farthest.
dialogue.zh: 對，中間能蓋得最遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hallway outlet is perfect then.
dialogue.zh: 那走廊的插座剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a solid halfway spot.
dialogue.zh: 對，那是穩妥的中間點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plugging it in now. Lights on.
dialogue.zh: 現在插上，燈亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a minute to pair up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt tə pɛr ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 給它一分鐘來配對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pair up? Like with the router?
dialogue.zh: 配對？是跟路由器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they link up on their own.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ lɪŋk ʌp ɑn ðɛr ˈoʊn./
dialogue.zh: 對，它們會自己連起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it's blinking blue slowly.
dialogue.zh: 現在它緩慢地閃藍燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue means it's searching for ours.
dialogue.zh: 藍色代表它在找我們的網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a code for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə koʊd fər ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要輸入什麼密碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just press the button on both.
dialogue.zh: 只要兩台各按一次按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pressed the router one. Now this?
dialogue.zh: 按了路由器那個，現在這個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, press the extender now too.
dialogue.zh: 對，現在也按下延伸器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Both lights are flashing.
dialogue.zh: 好了，兩盞燈都在閃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's them talking to each other.
dialogue.zh: 那是它們在互相溝通。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will I find the new network?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wɪl aɪ faɪnd ðə nju ˈnɛtˌwɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 我要怎麼找到新網路？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It adds EXT to our old name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ædz ɛksˈtiː tə aʊr oʊld neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 它在舊名稱後面加了 EXT。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same password, or a new one?
dialogue.zh: 密碼一樣還是新的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually the same as before.
dialogue.zh: 通常和之前那個一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see it. Connecting to EXT.
dialogue.zh: 我看到了，正連到 EXT。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go back to the far bedroom now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ bæk tə ðə fɑr ˈbɛdˌrum naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在回那間遠的臥室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walking there with my phone open.
dialogue.zh: 我開著手機走過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And tell me the bar count again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd tɛl mi ðə bɑr kaʊnt əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 然後再告訴我格數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, four full bars right here!
dialogue.zh: 哇，這裡四格訊號全滿！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The extender did its job then.
dialogue.zh: 那延伸器果真派上用場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Video started with no buffering!
dialogue.zh: 影片沒緩衝就開始了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Music streams fine in here too.
dialogue.zh: 音樂在這裡也能順利播放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This tiny plug changed everything.
dialogue.zh: 這個小插頭改變了一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheap fix, huge difference at home.
dialogue.zh: 花錢少，家裡差別卻超大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But it drops sometimes anyway.
dialogue.zh: 不過它偶爾還是會斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Occasionally for just a few seconds.
dialogue.zh: 偶爾斷個幾秒鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe the outside line is weak.
dialogue.zh: 也許是外面的線路太弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time to call the internet provider.
dialogue.zh: 該打電話給網路供應商了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we find their phone number?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi faɪnd ðɛr foʊn ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們去哪裡找他們的電話？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on the bill, or the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɑn ðə bɪl, ɔr ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 帳單上或 App 裡有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it on last month's bill.
dialogue.zh: 在上個月的帳單上找到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, go ahead and dial it.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，直接撥號吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It rang twice, then hold music.
dialogue.zh: 響了兩聲，然後是等待音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic. They always put us on hold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk. ðeɪ ˈɔlweɪz pʊt ʌs ɑn hoʊld./
dialogue.zh: 老套路，每次都讓我們等候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This saxophone loop is awful.
dialogue.zh: 這段薩克斯循環超難聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At least it beats silence.
dialogue.zh: 至少有音樂聽，比無聲好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A robot just asked for my account.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈroʊˌbɑt dʒʌst æskt fər maɪ əˈkaʊnt./
dialogue.zh: 機器人語音剛在問我的帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it in with the keypad.
dialogue.zh: 用撥號鍵盤輸入進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Now it lists more options.
dialogue.zh: 好了，現在列出更多選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press zero to reach a person.
dialogue.zh: 按零就能找真人接聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I pressed zero. Back to music.
dialogue.zh: 我按了零，又是音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh, hold on a little longer.
dialogue.zh: 唉，再堅持一下下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finally, a real human voice!
dialogue.zh: 終於，是真人的聲音！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say hi and explain the problem.
dialogue.zh: 打個招呼，說明一下問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, our internet keeps dropping out.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我們的網路一直斷線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask them to check the line.
dialogue.zh: 請他們檢查線路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked for my street address.
dialogue.zh: 她要我的街道地址。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it clearly, word by word.
dialogue.zh: 唸清楚，一個字一個字報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's typing something on her end.
dialogue.zh: 她在那頭打字記錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's checking your signal remotely.
dialogue.zh: 她在遠端幫你檢查訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says my line looks weak.
dialogue.zh: 她說我的線路看起來偏弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask what's causing the weakness.
dialogue.zh: 問問是什麼原因造成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's an outage near us today.
dialogue.zh: 她說今天我們這附近有線路中斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh! So it's not our fault at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ! soʊ ɪts nɑt aʊr fɔlt æt ɔl./
dialogue.zh: 噢！那根本不是我們的錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Correct. She's fixing it from there.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，她正在那邊修復。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask how long the repair takes.
dialogue.zh: 問問修理要花多久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About an hour, she said.
dialogue.zh: 她說大約一個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's not too bad at all.
dialogue.zh: 那完全不算太糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She also offered an upgrade.
dialogue.zh: 她還提供了一個升級。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An upgrade? Like a faster plan?
dialogue.zh: 升級？像是更快的方案？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, more speed for a small fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, mɔr spid fər ə smɔl fi./
dialogue.zh: 對，加一點錢換更快的速度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask how much extra each month.
dialogue.zh: 問問每個月要多付多少。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just five more dollars a month.
dialogue.zh: 每個月只要多付五塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That seems fair for faster net.
dialogue.zh: 為了更快的網路，這很公道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But our router is quite old too.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aʊr ˈraʊtər ɪz kwaɪt oʊld tu./
dialogue.zh: 不過我們的路由器也太舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask if the upgrade includes one.
dialogue.zh: 問問升級會不會附新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says a new router is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ə nju ˈraʊtər ɪz fri./
dialogue.zh: 她說新路由器是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. Then we should take it.
dialogue.zh: 完美，那我們應該接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll mail it within a few days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil meɪl ɪt wɪˈðɪn ə fju deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 她會在幾天內寄來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask about the technician option too.
dialogue.zh: 也問問技師上門的選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tech can come set it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɛk kæn kʌm sɛt ɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 技師可以上門來安裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Would that cost extra money?
dialogue.zh: 那要另外加錢嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, it's included with the upgrade.
dialogue.zh: 不用，升級方案已包含。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let's book a home visit.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就預約上門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked which day works best.
dialogue.zh: 她問哪一天最方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her any weekend afternoon.
dialogue.zh: 告訴她任何週末下午都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday two to four, she wrote.
dialogue.zh: 她寫下週六兩點到四點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I'll be home for that.
dialogue.zh: 完美，那段時間我在家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She gave me a reference number.
dialogue.zh: 她給了我一個參考號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it down and keep it safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt daʊn ænd kip ɪt seɪf./
dialogue.zh: 把它抄下來收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saved it in my phone notes.
dialogue.zh: 存進手機的備忘錄了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, you'll need it that day.
dialogue.zh: 好，當天你會用得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll text a reminder first.
dialogue.zh: 她會先傳簡訊提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, so we won't forget.
dialogue.zh: 不錯，這樣就不會忘記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before we hang up, one question.
dialogue.zh: 掛電話前，還有一個問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask her about the fix status.
dialogue.zh: 問問她修復的進度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the outage already cleared?
dialogue.zh: 中斷已經排除了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says it's done right now.
dialogue.zh: 她說現在剛剛修好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me test my phone again.
dialogue.zh: 讓我再測一次手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, try loading a page.
dialogue.zh: 快，試著載入一個網頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It loaded instantly. No spin!
dialogue.zh: 馬上就載入了，沒有轉圈！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the line is truly back.
dialogue.zh: 所以線路真的恢復了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll thank her for all her help.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl θæŋ hɜr fər ɔl hɜr hɛlp./
dialogue.zh: 我要謝謝她所有的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she was really kind.
dialogue.zh: 對，她真的很好心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's closing the ticket now.
dialogue.zh: 她現在正在結這個工單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we can hang up soon.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們馬上就可以掛電話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the call has ended.
dialogue.zh: 好，通話結束了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, are we fixed for good?
dialogue.zh: 所以，我們徹底修好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For now, yes. The net is stable.
dialogue.phonetic: /fər nɑʊ, jɛs. ðə nɛt ɪz ˈsteɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 目前是，網路很穩定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the new router comes Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 新路由器週六就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we won't need the extender.
dialogue.zh: 那我們就不需要延伸器了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it anyway for the back yard.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ˈɛniˌweɪ fər ðə bæk jɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 還是留著給後院用吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea. The yard is always weak.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə. ðə jɑrd ɪz ˈɔlˌweɪz wik./
dialogue.zh: 好主意，後院一直很弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The extender helps out there too.
dialogue.zh: 延伸器在外面也幫得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't believe we fixed so much.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kænt bɪˈliv wi fɪkst soʊ mʌʧ./
dialogue.zh: 我不敢相信我們修好這麼多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We really learned a lot tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚真的學到很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First we checked the symptoms.
dialogue.zh: 我們先檢查了症狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we restarted and fixed the cord.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi rɪˈstɑrtəd ænd fɪkst ðə kɔrd./
dialogue.zh: 然後重啟並修好了線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we moved and extended it.
dialogue.zh: 再來移動位置又加了延伸器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And called the provider last.
dialogue.zh: 最後才打給供應商。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple steps, big result.
dialogue.zh: 步驟很簡單，成效很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel smarter about Wi-Fi now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在對 Wi-Fi 更內行了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same here, less afraid of it.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不再怕它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time we'll fix it faster.
dialogue.zh: 下次我們能修得更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or maybe just call them first.
dialogue.zh: 或乾脆一開始就先打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that's honest at least.
dialogue.zh: 哈，那至少很誠實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's enjoy the working internet.
dialogue.zh: 我們來享受正常上線的網路吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put on that show you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pʊt ɑn ðæt ʃoʊ ju laɪk./
dialogue.zh: 對，播你愛看的那個節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one that froze earlier tonight.
dialogue.zh: 就是今晚早先卡住的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it won't stop or buffer.
dialogue.zh: 現在它不會停也不會緩衝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Music, video, all flowing smooth.
dialogue.zh: 音樂、影片，全都跑得順順的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is the best feeling tonight.
dialogue.zh: 這是今晚最棒的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm glad we didn't panic early.
dialogue.zh: 還好我們剛開始沒有慌張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One calm step at a time, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kɑm stɛp æt ə taɪm, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 一次只穩穩地走一步，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right. Patience plus a good call.
dialogue.zh: 對，耐心加上一通好電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That solved our Wi-Fi trouble.
dialogue.zh: 就解決了我們的 Wi-Fi 麻煩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So let's rest now, all online.
dialogue.zh: 那我們現在休息吧，全都在線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, with fast Wi-Fi too.
dialogue.zh: 晚安，也祝網速飛快。
